ImageDescription.value: Ceremony in the Arezzo Cathedral to honour the knights from Porta Santo Spirito as winners of the 2022 Saracen Joust (in Italian Giostra del Saracino) of Arezzo. In the event, that takes place in June and September, participate the four quarters of the town of Arezzo: Porta Crucifera, known as Culcitrone (green and red), Porta del Foro, known as Porta San Lorentino (yellow and crimson), Porta Sant'Andrea (white and green) and Porta del Borgo, today called Porta Santo Spirito (yellow and blue).

ImageDescription.value: Agriculture and the communities around the Hamun wetlands rely on Helmand river, but despite massive investments in infrastructure, water is becoming scarce on both sides of the Iran-Afghanistan border. According to the The Islamic Consultative Assembly (Iranian parliament), 25-30 percent of the region's population has emigrated to the suburbs of other cities in the past two decades due to water shortages.
